issues.jp_before: 三月[さんがつ]{ごろ|goro-time}{に|ni-time}日本[にほん]{に/へ|ni-destination}行[い]きます。
issues.problem: くらい before に is equally natural for an approximate month but was not listed.
issues.action: Added くらい as an alternative in the focus slot.

issues.jp_before: 来月[らいげつ]{の|no-possessive}十日[とおか]{ごろ|goro-time}{に|ni-time}試験[しけん]{が|ga-existence}あります。
issues.problem: The why claimed くらい would mean ten days; 来月の十日くらいに naturally means around the tenth.
issues.action: Added くらい as an alternative; rewrote why to contrast with ほど (a duration).

issues.jp_before: 兄[あに]{は|wa-topic}夜[よる]十二時[じゅうにじ]{ごろ|goro-time}{まで|made-until}働[はたら]きます。
issues.problem: 十二時くらいまで is equally natural but was not listed.
issues.action: Added くらい as an alternative.

issues.jp_before: 桜[さくら]{は|wa-topic}四月[しがつ]{ごろ|goro-time}{に|ni-time}咲[さ]きます。
issues.problem: 四月くらいに is equally natural but was not listed; lv 3 too high for this vocabulary.
issues.action: Added くらい as an alternative; set lv to 4.

issues.jp_before: 先生[せんせい]{は|wa-topic}二時[にじ]{ごろ/くらい|goro-time}教室[きょうしつ]{に|ni-destination}来[き]ます。
友達[ともだち]{が|ga-subject}四時[よじ]{ごろ/くらい|goro-time}うち{に|ni-destination}来[き]ました。
山田[やまだ]さん{は|wa-topic}先月[せんげつ]{の|no-possessive}十五日[じゅうごにち]{ごろ|goro-time}大阪[おおさか]{に|ni-destination}行[い]きました。
彼女[かのじょ]{は|wa-topic}五時[ごじ]{ごろ/くらい|goro-time}会社[かいしゃ]{を|o-departure}出[で]ました。
issues.problem: English 'left the company' can mean she quit; 会社を出る here means leaving work.
issues.action: Changed English to 'She left the office around five.'

issues.jp_before: 兄[あに]{は|wa-topic}ギター{や|ya-list}ドラム{など|nado-etc}{を|o-object}弾[ひ]きます。
issues.problem: Drums are 叩く, not 弾く; ドラムを弾く is wrong.
issues.action: Replaced ドラム with ピアノ; updated English and why.

issues.jp_before: 冷蔵庫[れいぞうこ]{に|ni-location}牛乳[ぎゅうにゅう]{や|ya-list}卵[たまご]{など|nado-etc}{が|ga-existence}あります。
issues.action: Changed to 'There's milk, eggs and so on in the fridge.'

issues.jp_before: リビング{に|ni-location}ソファー{や|ya-list}テレビ{など|nado-etc}{が|ga-existence}置[お]いてあります。
issues.problem: English 'are set in the living room' is unnatural.
issues.action: Changed to 'A sofa, a TV and other things have been put in the living room.'

issues.jp_before: かぜ{の|no-possessive}とき、熱[ねつ]{や|ya-list}せき{など|nado-etc}{が|ga-subject}出[で]ます。
issues.problem: English 'symptoms such as a fever and coughing appear' is stilted.
issues.action: Changed to 'When you have a cold, you get a fever, a cough and so on.'

issues.jp_before: 山[やま]{で|de-place}鳥[とり]{や|ya-list}虫[むし]{など|nado-etc}{の|no-possessive}声[こえ]{を|o-object}聞[き]きました。
issues.problem: 'voices of insects' is an unnatural rendering of 虫の声.
issues.action: Changed English to 'the sounds of birds, insects and so on'.
